name.ja: SD 三国創傑伝 龍賢劉備ユニコーンガンダム
name.en: SD Sangoku Soketsuden Ryuken Liu Bei Unicorn Gundam

description.ja: • 『三国志』をベースにしたSD ガンダムが装いも新たに登場！
description.en: • SD Gundam based on “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” has a new look!

description.ja: • 進化したプロポーションとパーツ分割へのこだわりにより、組み立てただけでSD史上最高峰の色分けを実現。
description.en: • Thanks to the advanced proportions and attention to part division, we have achieved the highest color separation in SD history using just the assembly.

description.ja: • 一新された頭身バランスと各所の関節構造により、躍動感あふれるポージングを再現！
description.en: • Reproduce dynamic poses with a completely new head and body balance and joint structure in various places!

description.ja: • ショク・エリアの諸葛亮、黄忠、趙雲、馬超、関羽雲長、張飛（別売り）との合体が可能！
description.en: • Can be combined with Shoku Area's Zhuge Liang, Huang Zhong, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao, Guan Yu Yuncho, and Zhang Fei (sold separately)!

description.ja: • 銃、剣モードに組み替え可能な龍弾破刃は背面に取り付け可能！
description.en: • The dragon bullet blade that can be rearranged into gun or sword mode can be attached to the back!

description.ja: • 万賢龍盾は肩に取り付き、ボールジョイントでフレキシブルに可動！
description.en: • Manken Dragon Shield attaches to the shoulder and can be moved flexibly with a ball joint!
